QuestInfo.name: Wild Goose Chase
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1022002##k in #b#m102000000##k says he's seen the mysterious stranger before. Find out more.
QuestInfo.1: According to #p1204020#, the mysterious stranger spent some time hunting #o2230102#s. Maybe if you hunt some yourself, you'll find a clue. #bIf you do, bring it to #p1012100##k
QuestInfo.2: You showed the clue from the #o2230102#s to #o2230102#. It sounded like someone had a grudge against you. \r\n\r\nWho could have a grudge against you in the present day?

0.0: He was here in #m102000000# not too long ago. He said he was on a training pilgrimage. When he was here in #m102000000#, he used to go to #m102030000# and hunt #r#o2230102#s#k.
0.1: #bHunting #o2230102#s? Maybe he left a clue behind. Or some kind of treasure. Or maybe a WHOLE LOT of treasure. I should definitely go...

yes.0: This is all I have to say. If you have what you need, please leave me.

no.0: #bHmph. This seems like a dead end.

1.0: Your Highness! I was worried the Black Wings had found you... Have you learned anything?

yes.0: According to this scroll, this nameless man is somehow connected to the Black Wings. But I don't think they ordered him to challenge you. It looks like #bhe has his own agenda#k.
yes.1: But this #rother person#k mentioned here? They seem to know you, Your Majesty. I'm worried about how much the Black Wings know about you. Please be careful, Your Highness.

npc.0: #p1204020# was hunting #r#o2230102#s#k in #m102000000#. For a very long time, apparently.

item.0: Good, you haven't been to #b#m102000000##k yet. Your Majesty, are you sure you wouldn't prefer me to go in your place?
